payload_force_policy: The block is a free nonkinematic rigid body with no joints, pose writes, or external support forces. Only the printer mechanism receives the generic bounded controller efforts; known block weight may be included in bed-actuator gravity compensation.
placement_policy: Freeze one clear source-bed top patch from independently tessellated original CAD before either arm runs. Transform that fixed point only by the declared source assembly alignment; its source top normal must map to world+Z. Do not select placement from submitted colliders, meshes or suggested author locations.
contact_unit_policy: Pinned ovphysx0.4.13 step_sync contact matrix is empirically impulse in Ns; divide each step by its actual dt to obtain N.
